title: Gazetteer Boundaries Extension
description: STAC Gazetteer Boundaries Extension for STAC Catalogs, Collections and Items. Upgrades a `gazetteer` search result's bbox to a polygon by declaring per-level, per-variant boundary assets and their join columns against the gazetteer names index. Depends on the gazetteer extension; this extension only constrains assets, wherever they appear.

asset.$comment: gazetteer:* field types below are scoped to the 'then' branch -- i.e. only enforced on assets with roles including 'gazetteer-boundaries' -- because the gazetteer extension reuses some of the same field names (e.g. gazetteer:feature_id_column, gazetteer:row_groups) on the gazetteer-index asset with a different allowed type or without the null case. Declaring the types unconditionally here would wrongly constrain that asset too.

gazetteer:feature_id_column.title: Feature id column
gazetteer:feature_id_column.description: The boundary file's own join column. An explicit JSON null is legal and meaningful -- distinct from the field being absent -- for files with no id column at all (e.g. geoBoundaries CGAZ ADM0).

gazetteer:index_key_column.title: Index key column
gazetteer:index_key_column.description: Which column of the gazetteer index is the join key, used when gazetteer:feature_id_column is null.

gazetteer:country_column.title: Country column
gazetteer:country_column.description: Narrows candidate row groups by country.

gazetteer:row_group_rows.title: Rows per row group
gazetteer:row_group_rows.description: Required for the geometry_ref fast path: the ref's row_group is checked against floor(row / row_group_rows).
